name: Impact Pro Batting Gloves
tagline: Multi-section protection with lightweight airflow comfort.
shortDescription: Premium batting gloves with split-finger flexibility and soft lining.
description: Impact Pro gloves are designed for long innings and faster hands. Reinforced finger chambers, cushioned palms, and breathable mesh panels help reduce fatigue while giving players a secure, high-grip feel through every shot.

name: Keeper Shield Wicket Gloves
tagline: Sharp grip and responsive catching support behind the stumps.
shortDescription: Match-ready wicket-keeping gloves with deep cups and supple leather palms.
description: Keeper Shield is built for quick takes, close-in standing, and dependable comfort over long sessions. The palm grip pattern is tuned for ball control while the inner lining stays soft and flexible throughout the innings.
